rationale.edition: Changed paths are web/scripts/check-css-tokens.mjs and web/src/views/Dashboards/RenderDashboardCharts.vue, both in the OSS frontend tree. No enterprise-owned paths (no enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/) and no enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/sensitive-data/logo-management) in the paths or symbol names, so the edition is OSS.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The change alters dashboard print/print-mode rendering, which is user-facing UI behavior, and there is no explicit opt-out: trigger_comment.txt and feature_hint.txt are both empty and no tests-added label was passed.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The change adds print-layout logic (preparePrintLayout/clearPrintLayout, beforeprint/afterprint window listeners, a watch on printMode, and print-media CSS) that changes how a dashboard renders when printed or when print mode is on, so the resulting user-facing flow should be verified end-to-end.
rationale.area: Dashboards. The only user-facing file changed is web/src/views/Dashboards/RenderDashboardCharts.vue, and sibling dashboard E2E specs live under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/.
rationale.group: Dashboards-Core. The change affects core dashboard grid/chart rendering (not a specific chart type or a single config panel), and the Dashboards-Core shard (actual_folder Dashboards) holds the general dashboard specs such as dashboard.spec.js and dashboard2.spec.js where a print-layout spec fits.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff. The changed files are a .mjs lint script and a .vue component, with no files under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/**, so there is no existing E2E coverage to extend (check-css-tokens.mjs is a build-time lint script, not E2E coverage).
